headline: North Korea Denies Involvement in Binance Crypto Heist Amid Withdrawals
summary: North Korea denied allegations linking it to a major crypto heist on Binance as customers withdrew billions.
why: Security breaches and regulatory or geopolitical accusations involving major cryptocurrency exchanges can trigger liquidity strains, large-scale customer withdrawals, and heightened systemic risk across the digital asset sector.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Massive customer withdrawals following security incidents pressure exchange reserves and platform stability.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports of a massive security breach and subsequent billions in customer withdrawals raise solvency and security concerns for the platform involved.
